notes: Added missing API, fallback logic validation, and unit test coverage stories for FEAT-1.

FEAT-1-STORY-082.title: Implement provider search API endpoint via FastAPI
FEAT-1-STORY-082.description: Expose provider search capability through a FastAPI endpoint that invokes find_care_facade, handles validated inputs, and returns standardized provider search results.

FEAT-1-STORY-083.title: Enforce vector search with taxonomy fallback sequencing
FEAT-1-STORY-083.description: Implement and validate logic in provider_search_service to ensure vector search executes first and taxonomy-based fallback triggers only when relevance thresholds or result counts are insufficient.

FEAT-1-STORY-084.title: Add unit tests for provider search service logic
FEAT-1-STORY-084.description: Create unit tests for provider_search_service covering vector search execution, taxonomy fallback triggering, location filtering, and result ranking behavior.

FEAT-1-STORY-085.title: Validate location filtering across state, city, and county levels
FEAT-1-STORY-085.description: Ensure provider search correctly applies multi-level geographic filtering including FIPS-to-county mapping and gracefully degrades when partial location data is provided.
